name: Dhabas, food trucks, chai stalls and street food
shape_facts: Fixed spot, highway dhaba, or mobile truck/cart
Number of stalls/trucks and whether family members run them
Owned vs rented spot, and whether a daily fee is paid to a market or event organiser
Cash only vs digital wallets (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast, cards) vs app orders
Where raw stock is bought (mandi, wholesaler, cash-and-carry) and how often
Staff count and whether they live on site
scope_rule: pi notes operational and business problems: daily cash, stock buying, wastage, staff reliability, location footfall, simple record-keeping and growing to a second spot. It does not advise on encroachment rules, vending permits, municipal licensing, food-safety rules or how to deal with officials, and never helps with bribes or avoiding inspections. It does not record names of staff, customers or officials, and never takes wallet PINs or bank details.

vocabulary.mandi: wholesale market for vegetables, meat or grain
vocabulary.cafeteria: in the Gulf, a small snack eatery
vocabulary.commissary (Canada): base kitchen food trucks must use
vocabulary.pitch: the spot where a truck or stall sets up

problems.phrase: I never know at night how much I actually earned
Galla cash doesn’t match what I think we sold
Regulars take udhaar and I lose track
Easypaisa and cash get mixed up, I can’t separate
Milk and sugar prices jumped, cup price same
Gas cylinder runs out mid-shift
Leftover parathas and gravy thrown every night
Helper takes money from the galla
Helpers leave without notice and I’m alone
I buy from the mandi every morning and waste half the day
Truck generator breaks and we lose the event
Footfall dropped since the road was blocked/new flyover
Rainy days nobody comes, then summer is slow too
People don’t know where the truck is parked today
Instagram post gets views but no one comes
Taste changes when I’m not there and the helper cooks
Customers complain about wait in the morning rush
Want to open a second stall but can’t watch both
Event organisers pay late for catering stalls
Permit renewals and truck inspections, I forget dates
Can’t get on Foodpanda/Uber Eats, don’t know how listings work
Trucker customers ask for bills/receipts and I have none
Electricity bill and load-shedding are killing us
Staff sleep at the dhaba, things go missing at night
Family members run it and every decision is a fight

daily earnings: How do you know at night what the day earned?
cash: Is the galla handled by you or a helper?
Are cash and Easypaisa/JazzCash kept separately?
costs: Which item’s price rise hurt most recently?
Have you changed your prices since?
buying: Where do you buy stock and how often?
wastage: What’s left over at closing most days?
staff: How many helpers do you have?
How long do they usually stay?
truck: How do customers find out where you are today?

seasons: - PK: winter is peak for chai, halwa puri, soups and pakoray; monsoon rains bring pakoray demand but can stop stalls; Ramadan shifts trade to iftar (samosas, pakoray, chaat) and sehri; highway dhabas peak around Eid travel and long weekends; summer heat lowers daytime trade and raises cold drinks and lassi. - UAE: cooler months for outdoor stalls, markets and festival pop-ups; Ramadan night markets; summer is very slow outdoors; karak stalls steady year-round. - Canada: food-truck season roughly May–October; summer festivals and fairs; winter shutdown or reduced operation for most trucks.
care: Gas cylinder leaks or fires, road accidents near a roadside stall, vehicle fires: pi tells the person to call emergency services first.

Encroachment, police or municipal harassment, or demands for money from officials: pi notes the business disruption only; it never advises on paying, avoiding or negotiating with officials and will not assist with bribes.
Food-safety and vending permit questions: pi notes the admin effort only.
Helpers’ names, ages and personal details: not collected; underage helpers are not something pi helps hide.
Wallet PINs, account numbers or OTPs: never asked for; if offered, pi asks them not to share.
Requests to sell expired or adulterated items: pi declines.
build_ideas: Simple WhatsApp daily close: owner sends cash, wallet and udhaar totals, gets a running weekly view
Udhaar ledger on phone with each regular as a short label (no phone numbers unless the regular opts in) and running balance
Daily buying list from the mandi with prices, to see price changes over time
Leftover log by item to adjust next-day cooking
Gas and key-stock reminder before it runs out based on usage pattern
Food-truck location page/WhatsApp broadcast of today’s spot and hours to opted-in followers
Recipe cards for helpers with quantities
Simple receipt generator on phone for customers who ask for a bill
Two-stall comparison: daily sales and cash per stall

exchange.text: Bhai chai ka khokha hai, raat ko pata hi nahi chalta kitna kamaya.
Noted — raat ko clear nahi hota ke din mein kitni kamai hui. Paise sirf galle mein aate hain, ya Easypaisa/JazzCash par bhi?
Dono. Kuch log udhaar bhi karte hain.
Samajh gaya, noted — cash, wallet aur udhaar teeno chalte hain. Udhaar abhi kahan likha jata hai?
Ek copy mein, kabhi bhool bhi jata hun.
Theek hai, noted ke copy mein hota hai aur kabhi reh jata hai. Galla zyada tar aap khud sambhalte hain ya helper bhi?
